name: Adventure Drivers
author: Addicting Games
description: Adventure Drivers is a free racing game. You'll have to score, upgrade, and push yourself to the limit if you want to win in this free racing game. Adventure Drivers is a 2-D racing game where you compete against other opponents on an endless 2D platform. This is a game of speed and balance. If you want to be the best you don't just have to move fast but you have to do it while respecting the laws of physics. Earn coin to upgrade your ride and customize the look, feel, and playability of the game until you are ready to conquer the competition and take the number one spot. Watch out for ramps and jumps, tunnels, and various obstacles. If you want to win you'll have to be the best there is at what you do! Rocket up the leaderboard, leave your friend and enemies in the dust. This is the ultimate test of physics, balance, speed, and strategic upgrades. Prove to the world that you have what it takes to leave everyone else in the past. You are the future. You are forever now in Adventure Drivers, the ultimate balancing platform game.
